📚 Tax Awareness Series | Day 1

💰 What is Income Tax?

Income Tax is a tax paid to the Government on taxable income earned by an individual or business.

Your income may come from:
• Salary
• Business or Profession
• Rent
• Interest
• Capital Gains
• Other Sources

Filing your Income Tax Return (ITR) helps you report your income and tax details properly.

✨ Learn the basics. Understand your tax. Stay financially aware.
